segments.thi-ap10:3.3: Tattha me sukataṃ byamhaṃ, udahārena nimmitaṃ.
segments.thi-ap10:4.3: Dasaṭṭhānehi tā sabbā, abhibhomi sadā ahaṃ.
segments.thi-ap10:8.1: “Avuṭṭhikā disā natthi, santattā kuthitāpi [santattā kuthitā na ca (sī. pī.), santattā khuppitā hi me (syā.)] ca;
segments.thi-ap10:10.1: “Uṇhaṃ vā pariḷāho vā, sarīre me na vijjati;
segments.thi-ap10:10.3: Kāye ca me rajo natthi, dakadānassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.thi-ap10:14.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.thi-ap10:16.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ udakadāyikā bhikkhunī imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
segments.thi-ap10:21.1: Dīpadā dakadā ceva, gāthāyo gaṇitā iha;
segments.thi-ap10:21.3: Ekagāthāsatañceva, tiṃsati ca taduttari [sattarasaṃ taduttari (syā.), sattādasa taduttariṃ (pī.)].
